Tabelog not consulted: Cf-Mitigated: challenge (403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ WORTH A RE-CHECK RATHER THAN A SHRUG, BECAUSE OF WHAT IT IS. 甘味 shops are the best dessert format in Japan for both diets — the 甘味処 西山 record elsewhere in this set shows why: 寒天 (agar, from seaweed), あんこ (azuki and sugar), 白玉 (glutinous RICE flour) and 黒蜜 are all plant and all wheat-free, so anmitsu, mamekan and zenzai are routinely safe on both counts where nothing else on a Japanese menu is. A kanmi counter that sells out daily is exactly the kind of place worth the phone call. But nothing about THIS shop’s bowls is published, and the general shape of the category is not evidence about this kitchen — so no items are recorded.
